# sorts
sort JSt = struct FREE | QUEUED | RUNNING | FAILED | DONE | GAVEUP;  % enumeration
sort Job = struct job(jx: Nat);  % record
# maps
map gen_init_slots: Nat -> Nat;
map retries: Nat;
map spent: Nat -> Bool;
# equations
gen_init_slots(w) = w;
retries = 2;
spent(t) = (t >= retries);
# actions
act c_crashed: Job;
act c_finished: Job;
act c_give_up: Job;
act c_retry: Job;
act c_start: Job;
act c_submit: Job;
# parameters
w: Nat = 2
nj: Nat = 0
st: Job -> JSt = (lambda j: Job . FREE)
tries: Job -> Nat = (lambda j: Job . 0)
Q: FSet(Job) = {}
slots: Nat = 2
entered: JSt -> Nat = (lambda s: JSt . 0)
byTries: Nat -> Nat = (lambda t: Nat . 0)
# summands (6, delta summands 1)
summand c_submit
  sum j: Job
  cond (jx(j) == nj)
  act  c_submit(j)
  nj := (nj + 1)
  st := st[j -> QUEUED]
  Q := (Q + ({j} + {}))
  entered := entered[QUEUED -> Pos2Nat((entered(QUEUED) + 1))]
summand c_finished
  sum j: Job
  cond (st(j) == RUNNING)
  act  c_finished(j)
  st := st[j -> DONE]
  slots := (slots + 1)
  entered := entered[DONE -> Pos2Nat((entered(DONE) + 1))]
summand c_crashed
  sum j: Job
  cond (st(j) == RUNNING)
  act  c_crashed(j)
  st := st[j -> FAILED]
  slots := (slots + 1)
  entered := entered[FAILED -> Pos2Nat((entered(FAILED) + 1))]
summand c_give_up
  sum j: Job
  cond ((st(j) == FAILED) && (2 <= tries(j)))
  act  c_give_up(j)
  st := st[j -> GAVEUP]
  entered := entered[GAVEUP -> Pos2Nat((entered(GAVEUP) + 1))]
summand c_retry
  sum j: Job
  cond ((st(j) == FAILED) && !(2 <= tries(j)))
  act  c_retry(j)
  st := st[j -> QUEUED]
  Q := (Q + ({j} + {}))
  entered := entered[QUEUED -> Pos2Nat((entered(QUEUED) + 1))]
summand c_start
  sum j: Job
  cond ((j in Q) && (0 < slots))
  act  c_start(j)
  st := st[j -> RUNNING]
  tries := tries[j -> Pos2Nat((tries(j) + 1))]
  Q := (Q - ({j} + {}))
  slots := Int2Nat((slots - 1))
  entered := entered[RUNNING -> Pos2Nat((entered(RUNNING) + 1))]
  byTries := byTries[Pos2Nat((tries(j) + 1)) -> Pos2Nat((byTries(Pos2Nat((tries(j) + 1))) + 1))]
# accepted
